# Uniting to Save and Sustain Lives

## Redefining Healthcare Delivery

We are everywhere healthcare happens – and everywhere it is going, with essential solutions in the
hospital, physician’s office and other sites of care. Every day, millions of patients and healthcare
providers rely on our unmatched portfolio of connected solutions, medical devices, and advanced
injectable technologies to help deliver smarter, more personalized care. Together, we are redefining
how care is delivered to make a greater impact today, tomorrow, and beyond.

[Nurse holding a mobile device]

## The future of healthcare is connected

Healthcare is at a turning point. Clinicians face growing workloads, while patients increasingly
expect seamless, coordinated experiences. Despite recent advances in technology, medical devices and
clinical systems continue to be isolated from each other, preventing effective data sharing,
creating inefficiencies and increasing the potential for gaps in care. The future demands better
connectivity.
* **100,000** nurses left the workforce during the COVID-19 pandemic
* **610,338** nurses reported intent to leave by 2027

# EACTS/STS/AATS Guidelines: Temporary Mechanical Circulatory Support (tMCS) in Cardiac Surgery

Early tMCS Is Now a Class I Recommendation for Cardiogenic Shock
[ Learn More ][63]

### The U.S. Food and Drug Administration (FDA) has determined Impella is safe and effective for its
### intended uses.
* **1,500+**
  
  Peer reviewed clinical studies have published on Impella, including DanGer Shock RCT published in
  the New England Journal of Medicine
* **17**
  
  Clinical Guidelines and Consensus statements
* **400,000+**
  
  Patients have been treated with Impella heart pumps

[For Interventional Cardiologists]

## For Interventional Cardiologists

Treat high-risk PCI, cardiogenic shock and right heart failure patients

[ Learn More ][64]
[For Cardiac and Vascular Surgeons]

## For Cardiac and Vascular Surgeons

Escalate, stabilize and recover native organs with minimally-invasive surgical techniques

[ Learn More ][65]
[For Nurses]

## For Nurses

Use calculators, watch quick skills videos and learn patient management best practices

[ Explore Resources ][66]
[For Fellows]

## For Fellows

Advance your knowledge and develop skills to treat complex PCI patients

[ Explore Resources ][67]

## For Referring Providers

Are you caring for patients with heart disease? Learn more about how Impella heart pumps work, the
benefits of Protected PCI with Impella and explore patient identification resources. 

[ Learn More ][68]

## Native Heart and Lung Recovery

### Conditions & Therapies

Access education, clinical evidence and practice support for Protected PCI, AMI cardiogenic shock,
right heart failure, surgical applications and severe lung failure.

[ Learn More ][69]

### Products & Services

Learn about the latest technology and how that technology may best support your patient.

[ Learn More ][70]

### Education & Resources

Abiomed provides a comprehensive training program for health care providers.

[ Learn More ][71]

## Healthcare Professionals

Committed to helping you enhance your practice and the experience of your patients through connected
devices and digitalised data sharing.

[Healthcare Professionals][9]
* [ Primary Care ][10]
  
  Supporting every aspect of your clinical practice, including physical exam, diagnostic cardiology,
  vitals monitoring and vision screening
* [ Hospital Care ][11]
  
  Advancing products and technologies designed to speed patient recovery and streamline clinical
  workflows
* [ Surgical Care ][12]
  
  Delivering innovations that enable reduced operating times, faster patient recovery and improved
  outcomes
* [ Nutritional Care ][13]
  
  Personalizing nutritional care designed to improve patients’ health in the hospital, the ICU and
  at home
* [ Respiratory Health ][14]
  
  Helping your patients with respiratory therapies designed to simplify delivery and improve
  mobility
* [ Our Products & Services ][15]
  
  Our portfolio of acute, nutritional, hospital and surgical care products helps advance healthcare
  around the world.

## Perspectives

For nearly a century, we have worked at the intersection of saving and sustaining lives.

[Perspectives][16]
* [ Patients' Stories ][17]
  
  Patients’ journeys inspire our work and drive our commitment.
* [ Healthcare Insights ][18]
  
  We’re engaging with industry thought leaders to explore how science and innovation advance
  healthcare.
* [ People of Baxter ][19]
  
  We are a community of diverse professionals working together to drive better healthcare options.
* [ Community Engagement ][20]
  
  Enriching the communities where we live and work.

## Our Story

Our 90-year heritage gives us distinct perspective on the needs of patients and caregivers. We lead
today by putting those insights to work to deliver new, better healthcare solutions and access to
care in the communities where we live and work.

[Our Story][21]
* [ Our Leadership ][22]
  
  Our forward-looking leadership team is a driving force in ensuring we meet the needs of all our
  stakeholders – every day and everywhere.
* [ Our Governance ][23]
  
  We are proud of our strong commitment to maintaining the highest standards of corporate
  governance.
* [ Fueling Collaborative Innovation ][24]
  
  Nurturing a culture of innovation is critical to delivering on our mission to save and sustain
  lives. We partner with the healthcare community to continually find more efficient, smarter ways
  to help solve the world's most pressing healthcare challenges.
* [ Baxter Sustainability ][25]
  
  We strive to create lasting value by delivering sustainable healthcare, advancing climate and
  resiliency, and championing our people and communities.
* [ Inclusion & Diversity ][26]
  
  We are committed to attracting, motivating and retaining an inclusive and diverse workforce.
* [ Our History ][27]
  
  For nearly a century, we’ve been focused on saving and sustaining lives and elevating patient
  care.

## Patients

Helping you reach a healthy life, full of possibility.

[Patients][28]
* [ General Healthcare ][29]
  
  Whether you are receiving care in the hospital, at your doctor’s office or at home, we are here to
  support every step of your journey.
* [ Nutritional Care ][30]
  
  When medical conditions prevent you from adequately feeding yourself, we provide life-saving
  clinical nutrition options to help you regain your nutritional status.
* [ Respiratory Health ][31]
  
  We are committed to helping you with innovative products that deliver effective, proven
  respiratory therapy in the hospital and at home.

# Uniting to Save and Sustain Lives

## Redefining Healthcare Delivery

We are everywhere healthcare happens – and everywhere it is going, with essential solutions in the
hospital, physician’s office and other sites of care. Every day, millions of patients and healthcare
providers rely on our unmatched portfolio of connected solutions, medical devices, and advanced
injectable technologies to help deliver smarter, more personalized care. Together, we are redefining
how care is delivered to make a greater impact today, tomorrow, and beyond.

[Nurse holding a mobile device]

## The future of healthcare is connected

Healthcare is at a turning point. Clinicians face growing workloads, while patients increasingly
expect seamless, coordinated experiences. Despite recent advances in technology, medical devices and
clinical systems continue to be isolated from each other, preventing effective data sharing,
creating inefficiencies and increasing the potential for gaps in care. The future demands better
connectivity.
* **100,000** nurses left the workforce during the COVID-19 pandemic
* **610,338** nurses reported intent to leave by 2027

Working, studying or living abroad? Our international health insurance plans help protect expat
individuals, professionals, students and families as they work and live abroad. Explore our plans
and choose the international expat healthcare cover that’s perfect for you. Only away for less than

## **Consistent cover for your employees**

We understand that in today's globalized world, businesses often have employees spread across
different regions.  With our regional plans, you can ensure consistent and reliable coverage for
your employees worldwide. Our Summit plans are designed to meet the unique healthcare needs of each
region, while also ensuring compliance with local regulations. We provide administration services,
cover for insurance risks, or a combination of both.

### **[Multinational
### Pooling][113]**
###  
###  
###  

Consolidates local employee benefit plans from two or more countries into one account (pool) to
assess the overall global result, enabling the client to receive a potential international
dividend.   

### **[Global
### Underwriting][114]**
###  
###  
###  

Based on the portfolio assessment, it replaces local pricing with global underwriting. This results
in more stable prices and better terms and conditions.

### **[ Captive
### Reinsurance][115]**
###  
###  
###  

Combines employee benefit plans from multiple countries into a corporate’s own captive via a
reinsurance mechanism allowing the company to manage its own risks. This program offers a
personalized online portal, providing access to high quality data analytics, insights and reporting.

### **[ Global
### Pension][116]**
###  
###  
###  

A central coordination of local solutions that helps multinational companies to increase governance
and efficiency across defined contribution (DC) plan and legacy defined benefit (DB) retirement
plans.

## CardioNerds Academy

The **CardioNerds Academy **was founded in January of 2021 to further the democratization of
cardiovascular education and to create digital content for asynchronous medical education with the
overarching mission of marrying content creation with personal and professional development. 

The Academy harnesses the entire CardioNerds network and platform to facilitate mentorship,
networking, and collaborative efforts at the national and international level.

CardioNerds academy fellows are divided into 4 equal **“Houses of Cards” **that are named after
cardiology legends, [**Vivien Thomas, Helen Taussig, Edith Jones, and Willem Einthoven**][123]**.**

# [Vitalstream by Caretaker Medical]

You can't manage what you can't see.

One device for both non-invasive & a-line continuous hemodynamic monitoring.

VitalStream is built to prevent complications before they start, across every point of care, from
pre-op through discharge.

[ Schedule a Demo ][19]
[ How it Works ][20]

### Trusted by 150+ Clinical Customers

[Row rect Shape]
[Vitalstream Wearable on wrist]

## ICU-Level Precision.
## No Longer Confined to the ICU.

For decades, continuous beat-by-beat monitoring was only available through invasive arterial lines
in the most critical care settings — leaving millions of patients in dangerous blind spots.

VitalStream sets a new standard. Whether invasively or non-invasively, our multi-modal device
delivers continuous hemodynamic intelligence wherever the patient is, so every clinician has what
they need to catch decompensation early and treat with confidence.

Until now, there were only two options: accept the blind spots that put patients at risk, or accept
the invasive lines that slow their recovery. Either way, the patient paid the price.

That tradeoff ends here.

[ Schedule a Demo ][21]

## What a Blind Spot Costs

A patient’s blood pressure reads as stable, but their Cardiac Output is silently declining.

You won’t realize until they crash, and you’re left managing a crisis instead of preventing one.

The delayed intervention, misread fluid status, or data that arrived too late can lead to longer ICU
stays, higher complication rates, and the increase the downstream costs of reactive care.

Now, multiply this across 50 million surgeries and 5 million ICU admissions, and the results could
cost the healthcare system billions every year.

VitalStream's validated accuracy changes that equation. By integrating **multimodal arterial line
connectivity with our continuous noninvasive monitoring**, you can see the "why" behind the vitals.
You can act earlier, with precision, and prevent the complications that turn routine recoveries into
extended ICU stays.

Behind every preventable deterioration is a moment of inadequate data. VitalStream is built to
eliminate that moment.

[ Schedule a Demo ][22]

VitalStream ART delivers continuous, beat-to-beat hemodynamic data — invasively and non-invasively —
through a single platform that moves with your patient from the moment they enter the hospital to
the moment they leave.

* **Invasive & non-invasive monitoring in one platform**
* **Works with any invasive arterial line **— no proprietary transducer required
* **Superior 10-day sensor life** — non-invasive sensors last for the entire patient stay
* **Beat-to-beat accuracy **validated across 20 peer-reviewed studies
* **Continuous streaming data** — no manual charting
* **Wire-free mobility** — no care gaps, 24/7 access to patient vitals
* **Integrates with GE Carescape and Philips Intellivue**
* **Operational in under 90 seconds** — no complex setup required.

We aren't just a monitor; we are a complication-avoidance platform.

One device. The same hemodynamic record. From admission to discharge.

Monitoring begins before the patient enters the OR — wirelessly, noninvasively, with no arterial

[step 3]

# Heartplace

## Cardiologists & Vascular Specialists located in Dallas Fort Worth and the North Texas Region

HeartPlace is the largest physician-owned cardiology group in North Texas, with cardiovascular
disease and cardiac electrophysiology specialists who consistently appear on ***D Magazine*** and
***Texas Monthly***'s “Top Doctors” lists. The practice has several clinics convenient to you under
the **HeartPlace** and **Fort Worth Heart brand** names across the region, serving patients in
Allen, Keller, Arlington, Fort Worth, Dallas, Plano, Corsicana, Garland, Glen Rose, Granbury,
Bedford, Burleson, Irving, Mansfield, Mesquite, Richardson, North Richland Hills, Red Oak, and
Stephenville.

The multidisciplinary HeartPlace and Fort Worth Heart teams aim to improve and protect the heart and
vascular health of all their patients in these North Texas communities. Their cardiovascular disease
specialists deliver the highest quality of care for a comprehensive range of cardiac and circulatory
diseases, including [heart disease][95], [arrhythmia][96], [carotid artery disease][97], [peripheral
vascular disease][98], [hypertension][99], [high cholesterol][100], and venous conditions. 

HeartPlace has sophisticated cardiac imaging and other diagnostic technologies onsite so patients
have fast, easy access to duplex ultrasound, [echocardiography][101], electrocardiography, [nuclear
stress testing][102], and portable event and Holter monitoring. HeartPlace also offers convenient
mobile check-in for consultations.

In addition to their diagnostic services, HeartPlace provides an equally impressive selection of
treatments, including endovenous chemical thermal ablation, alcohol septal ablation, implantable
defibrillators, pacemakers, and LVADs (left ventricular assist devices), as well as minimally
invasive catheterization procedures such as atherectomy, balloon angioplasty and stenting, and
thrombolysis. 

HeartPlace’s skilled surgeons also perform advanced cardiothoracic surgeries, including cardiac
bypass, ASD (atrial septal defect) and PFO (patent foramen ovale) closure for holes in the heart,
and off-pump cardiac surgery.

Patients at HeartPlace receive a warm welcome and professional treatment delivered with compassion
and consideration at every office. To arrange your visit, call your closest HeartPlace location
today.

What is Henry?

Henry is a telehealth service that makes it easy and affordable to get the medical care you need. We
help people manage weight loss, perimenopause and testosterone hormone therapies, and erectile
dysfunction, as well as other conditions. It’s easy to get started—just answer a few questions about
your health and lifestyle goals, and we’ll connect you with an expert provider. If medically
approved, you’ll get your prescribed medication by mail within a week. There’s no insurance
required. Just a simple monthly bill with your provider visits, medication and supplies, and ongoing
care included.

How does Henry work?

Henry makes it easy to get the personalized care you need in just a few steps. Answer a few
questions about your health and goals. A licensed healthcare provider will review your information
and recommend treatment if necessary. If prescribed, you’ll get your medication by mail within a few
days. There’s no insurance stress or surprise bills. Just one monthly payment that includes your
provider visit, medication and supplies, and ongoing care.

Who can use Henry?

Henry is open to all adults! To use Henry, you must: Be 18 years or older. Have a demonstrated
medical need for treatment. Live or have an address in one of the states we support.

How do I see a provider?

Click any “Get Started” button and answer a few questions about your health and lifestyle goals.
You’ll then be able to schedule a provider visit face-to-face with a video call, or depending on
your home state, choose an independent provider review without a video call. You and your provider
will be able to exchange messages through our secure patient portal.

Does Henry require a long-term contract?

No long-term contracts! Henry offers convenient monthly plans, as well as longer term plans for
certain treatments. You can easily cancel any time.

How soon will I receive my medication?

Most people receive their medication within 8-10 business days after they speak to their provider.
Just a heads up, people in California may experience longer fulfillment times because of additional
compound testing requirements.

studies. Opinionated discussions on controversial topics are welcomed.

About company TahatAksi

TahatAksi is a family-owned company incorporated in 1994 in Minsk, Belarus. The company has
established itself as a fast-growing manufacturer of medical equipment, specializing in hypothermia
prevention and treatment systems and equipment for both newborns and adults. TahatAksi produces a
range of medical devices, including warming systems for infants, patient warming systems, blood and
infusion warmers, blood and plasma thawers, and warming cabinets for medical fluids and blankets.

Hospital equipment manufacturing company TahatAksi is recognized for its commitment to quality,
implementing a Total Quality Control System that is certified under EN ISO 9001:2015 and EN ISO
13485:2016 standards. Our TAHAT products have also received CE certification, ensuring compliance
with European medical device regulations. TahatAksi serves over 35 countries worldwide and is known
for its focus on creating cost-effective, advanced solutions that meet the demands of healthcare
professionals.

Areas of care
TahatAksi offers advanced solutions in several key medical fields, focusing on improving patient
care and treatment through qualitative high-quality equipment. Manufacturing hospital equipment
include:
* Prevention and Treatment of Hypothermia
  TahatAksi manufactures warming systems for newborns and adults to prevent inadvertent hypothermia
  during perioperative periods or critical and intensive care. These include portable and stationary
  devices to maintain patients’ core body temperature effectively.
* Infant Care
  TAHAT manufactures newborn warming systems, such as the RAMONAK series, designed to ensure thermal
  support for infants in neonatal intensive care units (NICUs) and maternity and obstetrics clinics
  and hospitals.
* Blood and Infusion Solutions Warming
  TahatAksi offers a variety of blood and fluid warming devices, including the AMPIR-01 and
  AMPIRMini series, which ensure that IV fluids and blood products are safely warmed before infusion
  into patients, reducing risks associated with cold infusions. Healthcare facilities looking to buy
  medical equipment for safe infusions will find these solutions critical.
* Medical Warming Cabinets
  Our THERMO cabinets are designed to warm medical fluids, blankets, and other materials, ensuring
  they are prepared for use in various medical settings. These cabinets are a staple in the
  company's distribution of medical equipment, providing reliable thermal management.
* Plasma Thawing Devices
  The PlasmaBox thawing device is used for safe and efficient thawing of blood and plasma, as well
  as other plasma products, making it an essential tool in transfusion and emergency care units and
  blood banks. Clinics seeking to buy medical equipment for safe plasma handling will benefit from
  this innovative solution.
* Our mission
  TahatAksi's mission of production of medical equipment is to improve patient care through
  innovative, reliable, and cost-effective medical equipment. The company is dedicated to enhancing
  health outcomes by providing high-quality products that meet the rigorous demands of healthcare
  professionals globally, with a focus on safety, efficiency, and patient comfort.

# Treaton — Your Trusted Partner in Medical Equipment for Anesthesiology and Intensive Care

Treaton (Triton Electronic Systems Ltd.) is a leading Russian manufacturer specializing in the
development, production, and full-service support of high-tech medical equipment for anesthesiology,
intensive care units (ICU), resuscitation, and emergency medicine. With more than 35 years of
experience, we deliver reliable, innovative, and safe solutions that medical professionals trust
every day.

Our equipment is successfully used by leading medical institutions, including the Ministry of
Health, Ministry of Internal Affairs, Ministry of Defense, and Ministry of Emergency Situations of
the Russian Federation, as well as by partners in over 40 countries worldwide.

## Comprehensive Range of Medical Equipment

### Mechanical Ventilators and Respiratory Support Systems

We manufacture a wide range of modern ventilators designed for intensive care, transport, and
emergency situations. Our devices support both invasive and non-invasive ventilation for adult,
pediatric, and neonatal patients.

#### ZisLine MV350 — Advanced ICU Ventilator

High-performance intensive care ventilator with advanced ventilation modes and excellent monitoring
capabilities.

#### ZisLine T100 — Portable Transport Ventilator

Compact and reliable transport ventilator ideal for ambulances, intra-hospital transport, and
emergency medical services.

### Patient Monitoring Systems

Treaton offers high-precision patient monitors and central monitoring stations that provide
real-time monitoring of vital signs in operating rooms and intensive care units.

### OEM Modules and Components

We develop and supply advanced OEM solutions for medical device manufacturers, including:

#### Mainstream and Sidestream Gas Analysis Modules

High-accuracy CO₂, O₂, and anesthetic gas monitoring sensors for integration into anesthesia
machines and ventilators.

#### Depth of Anesthesia and Sedation Monitoring Modules

Advanced Brain Activity Index (AI) monitoring technology for safe and effective procedural sedation
and general anesthesia.

## Why Medical Institutions Choose Treaton

### Proven Quality and International Certification

All Treaton equipment undergoes strict quality control and meets international standards. Our
products are certified and regularly tested in real clinical conditions.

### Innovation Backed by 35 Years of Experience

#### Advanced Technologies Developed In-House

Our key developments include indirect calorimetry for metabolic assessment and unique non-invasive
hemodynamic monitoring technologies.

#### Continuous Research and Development

We constantly improve our products by implementing the latest achievements in biomedical engineering
and respiratory support.

### Reliable Service and Technical Support

We provide full lifecycle support for our equipment:

#### Warranty and Post-Warranty Maintenance

#### Extended Warranty Programs

#### Professional Training for Biomedical Engineers

#### 24/7 Technical Consultation and Prompt Repair Service

### Professional Team Dedicated to Your Success

Our team consists of experienced engineers, developers, anesthesiologists, and international sales
specialists who work closely with each client to deliver the best technical and commercial
solutions.

## Customized OEM Solutions for Medical Device Manufacturers

Treaton is a reliable OEM partner offering high-precision gas analysis modules, sedation monitoring
systems, and other critical components. We help manufacturers enhance their equipment with
cutting-edge technology while reducing development time and costs.

## Partner with Treaton Today

Contact our team to learn more about our full range of medical ventilators, patient monitors, OEM
modules, and comprehensive service programs. We are ready to provide tailored solutions that
perfectly match the needs of your hospital, clinic, or manufacturing project.

**Treaton — Advanced Medical Technology • Reliable Performance • Professional Support • 35 Years of
Excellence**

#### Advanced Technologies Developed In-House

Our key developments include indirect calorimetry for metabolic assessment and unique non-invasive
hemodynamic monitoring technologies.

#### Continuous Research and Development

We constantly improve our products by implementing the latest achievements in biomedical engineering
and respiratory support.

### Reliable Service and Technical Support

We provide full lifecycle support for our equipment:

#### Warranty and Post-Warranty Maintenance

#### Extended Warranty Programs

#### Professional Training for Biomedical Engineers

#### 24/7 Technical Consultation and Prompt Repair Service

### Professional Team Dedicated to Your Success

Our team consists of experienced engineers, developers, anesthesiologists, and international sales
specialists who work closely with each client to deliver the best technical and commercial
solutions.

## Customized OEM Solutions for Medical Device Manufacturers

Treaton is a reliable OEM partner offering high-precision gas analysis modules, sedation monitoring
systems, and other critical components. We help manufacturers enhance their equipment with
cutting-edge technology while reducing development time and costs.

Early tMCS Is Now a Class I Recommendation for Cardiogenic Shock
[ Learn More ][63]

### The U.S. Food and Drug Administration (FDA) has determined Impella is safe and effective for its
### intended uses.
* **1,500+**
  
  Peer reviewed clinical studies have published on Impella, including DanGer Shock RCT published in
  the New England Journal of Medicine
* **17**
  
  Clinical Guidelines and Consensus statements
* **400,000+**
  
  Patients have been treated with Impella heart pumps

Treat high-risk PCI, cardiogenic shock and right heart failure patients

### Pooling][113]**
###  
###  
###  

Consolidates local employee benefit plans from two or more countries into one account (pool) to
assess the overall global result, enabling the client to receive a potential international
dividend.   

### **[Global
### Underwriting][114]**
###  
###  
###  

Based on the portfolio assessment, it replaces local pricing with global underwriting. This results
in more stable prices and better terms and conditions.

### **[ Captive
### Reinsurance][115]**
###  
###  
###  

Combines employee benefit plans from multiple countries into a corporate’s own captive via a
reinsurance mechanism allowing the company to manage its own risks. This program offers a
personalized online portal, providing access to high quality data analytics, insights and reporting.

### Pension][116]**

###  
###  

A central coordination of local solutions that helps multinational companies to increase governance
and efficiency across defined contribution (DC) plan and legacy defined benefit (DB) retirement
plans.

nominates a CardioNerds Ambassador & contributes open-access content by way of CardioNerds Case
Reports Series.

**CardioNerds Ambassadors** are fellows nominated by CardioNerds fellowships to represent education
at their program.

The CardioNerds Healy Honor Roll is named after [**Dr. Bernadine Patricia Healy**][118], a
CardioNerd Hero who was the first female director of the National Institutes of Health and
accomplished incredible achievements during her career.

## CardioNerds Academy

The **CardioNerds Academy **was founded in January of 2021 to further the democratization of
cardiovascular education and to create digital content for asynchronous medical education with the
overarching mission of marrying content creation with personal and professional development. 

The Academy harnesses the entire CardioNerds network and platform to facilitate mentorship,
networking, and collaborative efforts at the national and international level.

CardioNerds academy fellows are divided into 4 equal **“Houses of Cards” **that are named after
cardiology legends, [**Vivien Thomas, Helen Taussig, Edith Jones, and Willem Einthoven**][123]**.**

You can't manage what you can't see.

One device for both non-invasive & a-line continuous hemodynamic monitoring.

VitalStream is built to prevent complications before they start, across every point of care, from

## ICU-Level Precision.
## No Longer Confined to the ICU.

For decades, continuous beat-by-beat monitoring was only available through invasive arterial lines
in the most critical care settings — leaving millions of patients in dangerous blind spots.

VitalStream sets a new standard. Whether invasively or non-invasively, our multi-modal device
delivers continuous hemodynamic intelligence wherever the patient is, so every clinician has what
they need to catch decompensation early and treat with confidence.

Until now, there were only two options: accept the blind spots that put patients at risk, or accept
the invasive lines that slow their recovery. Either way, the patient paid the price.

That tradeoff ends here.

[ Schedule a Demo ][21]

## What a Blind Spot Costs

A patient’s blood pressure reads as stable, but their Cardiac Output is silently declining.

You won’t realize until they crash, and you’re left managing a crisis instead of preventing one.

The delayed intervention, misread fluid status, or data that arrived too late can lead to longer ICU
stays, higher complication rates, and the increase the downstream costs of reactive care.

Now, multiply this across 50 million surgeries and 5 million ICU admissions, and the results could
cost the healthcare system billions every year.

VitalStream's validated accuracy changes that equation. By integrating **multimodal arterial line
connectivity with our continuous noninvasive monitoring**, you can see the "why" behind the vitals.
You can act earlier, with precision, and prevent the complications that turn routine recoveries into
extended ICU stays.

Behind every preventable deterioration is a moment of inadequate data. VitalStream is built to
eliminate that moment.

## ICU-Level Precision.
## No Longer Confined to the ICU.

For decades, continuous beat-by-beat monitoring was only available through invasive arterial lines
in the most critical care settings — leaving millions of patients in dangerous blind spots.

VitalStream sets a new standard. Whether invasively or non-invasively, our multi-modal device
delivers continuous hemodynamic intelligence wherever the patient is, so every clinician has what
they need to catch decompensation early and treat with confidence.

Until now, there were only two options: accept the blind spots that put patients at risk, or accept
the invasive lines that slow their recovery. Either way, the patient paid the price.

That tradeoff ends here.

[ Schedule a Demo ][21]

## What a Blind Spot Costs

A patient’s blood pressure reads as stable, but their Cardiac Output is silently declining.

You won’t realize until they crash, and you’re left managing a crisis instead of preventing one.

The delayed intervention, misread fluid status, or data that arrived too late can lead to longer ICU
stays, higher complication rates, and the increase the downstream costs of reactive care.

Now, multiply this across 50 million surgeries and 5 million ICU admissions, and the results could
cost the healthcare system billions every year.

connectivity with our continuous noninvasive monitoring**, you can see the "why" behind the vitals.

extended ICU stays.

HeartPlace is the largest physician-owned cardiology group in North Texas, with cardiovascular
disease and cardiac electrophysiology specialists who consistently appear on ***D Magazine*** and
***Texas Monthly***'s “Top Doctors” lists. The practice has several clinics convenient to you under
the **HeartPlace** and **Fort Worth Heart brand** names across the region, serving patients in
Allen, Keller, Arlington, Fort Worth, Dallas, Plano, Corsicana, Garland, Glen Rose, Granbury,
Bedford, Burleson, Irving, Mansfield, Mesquite, Richardson, North Richland Hills, Red Oak, and
Stephenville.

The multidisciplinary HeartPlace and Fort Worth Heart teams aim to improve and protect the heart and
vascular health of all their patients in these North Texas communities. Their cardiovascular disease
specialists deliver the highest quality of care for a comprehensive range of cardiac and circulatory
diseases, including [heart disease][95], [arrhythmia][96], [carotid artery disease][97], [peripheral
vascular disease][98], [hypertension][99], [high cholesterol][100], and venous conditions. 

HeartPlace has sophisticated cardiac imaging and other diagnostic technologies onsite so patients
have fast, easy access to duplex ultrasound, [echocardiography][101], electrocardiography, [nuclear
stress testing][102], and portable event and Holter monitoring. HeartPlace also offers convenient
mobile check-in for consultations.

In addition to their diagnostic services, HeartPlace provides an equally impressive selection of
treatments, including endovenous chemical thermal ablation, alcohol septal ablation, implantable
defibrillators, pacemakers, and LVADs (left ventricular assist devices), as well as minimally
invasive catheterization procedures such as atherectomy, balloon angioplasty and stenting, and
thrombolysis. 

HeartPlace’s skilled surgeons also perform advanced cardiothoracic surgeries, including cardiac
bypass, ASD (atrial septal defect) and PFO (patent foramen ovale) closure for holes in the heart,
and off-pump cardiac surgery.

Patients at HeartPlace receive a warm welcome and professional treatment delivered with compassion
and consideration at every office. To arrange your visit, call your closest HeartPlace location
today.

What is Henry?

Henry is a telehealth service that makes it easy and affordable to get the medical care you need. We
help people manage weight loss, perimenopause and testosterone hormone therapies, and erectile
dysfunction, as well as other conditions. It’s easy to get started—just answer a few questions about
your health and lifestyle goals, and we’ll connect you with an expert provider. If medically
approved, you’ll get your prescribed medication by mail within a week. There’s no insurance
required. Just a simple monthly bill with your provider visits, medication and supplies, and ongoing
care included.

How does Henry work?

Henry makes it easy to get the personalized care you need in just a few steps. Answer a few
questions about your health and goals. A licensed healthcare provider will review your information
and recommend treatment if necessary. If prescribed, you’ll get your medication by mail within a few
days. There’s no insurance stress or surprise bills. Just one monthly payment that includes your
provider visit, medication and supplies, and ongoing care.

Who can use Henry?

Henry is open to all adults! To use Henry, you must: Be 18 years or older. Have a demonstrated
medical need for treatment. Live or have an address in one of the states we support.

How do I see a provider?

Click any “Get Started” button and answer a few questions about your health and lifestyle goals.
You’ll then be able to schedule a provider visit face-to-face with a video call, or depending on
your home state, choose an independent provider review without a video call. You and your provider
will be able to exchange messages through our secure patient portal.

Does Henry require a long-term contract?

No long-term contracts! Henry offers convenient monthly plans, as well as longer term plans for
certain treatments. You can easily cancel any time.

How soon will I receive my medication?

Most people receive their medication within 8-10 business days after they speak to their provider.
Just a heads up, people in California may experience longer fulfillment times because of additional
compound testing requirements.

About company TahatAksi

TahatAksi is a family-owned company incorporated in 1994 in Minsk, Belarus. The company has
established itself as a fast-growing manufacturer of medical equipment, specializing in hypothermia
prevention and treatment systems and equipment for both newborns and adults. TahatAksi produces a
range of medical devices, including warming systems for infants, patient warming systems, blood and
infusion warmers, blood and plasma thawers, and warming cabinets for medical fluids and blankets.

Hospital equipment manufacturing company TahatAksi is recognized for its commitment to quality,
implementing a Total Quality Control System that is certified under EN ISO 9001:2015 and EN ISO
13485:2016 standards. Our TAHAT products have also received CE certification, ensuring compliance
with European medical device regulations. TahatAksi serves over 35 countries worldwide and is known
for its focus on creating cost-effective, advanced solutions that meet the demands of healthcare
professionals.

Areas of care
TahatAksi offers advanced solutions in several key medical fields, focusing on improving patient
care and treatment through qualitative high-quality equipment. Manufacturing hospital equipment
include:
* Prevention and Treatment of Hypothermia
  TahatAksi manufactures warming systems for newborns and adults to prevent inadvertent hypothermia
  during perioperative periods or critical and intensive care. These include portable and stationary
  devices to maintain patients’ core body temperature effectively.
* Infant Care
  TAHAT manufactures newborn warming systems, such as the RAMONAK series, designed to ensure thermal
  support for infants in neonatal intensive care units (NICUs) and maternity and obstetrics clinics
  and hospitals.
* Blood and Infusion Solutions Warming
  TahatAksi offers a variety of blood and fluid warming devices, including the AMPIR-01 and
  AMPIRMini series, which ensure that IV fluids and blood products are safely warmed before infusion
  into patients, reducing risks associated with cold infusions. Healthcare facilities looking to buy
  medical equipment for safe infusions will find these solutions critical.
* Medical Warming Cabinets
  Our THERMO cabinets are designed to warm medical fluids, blankets, and other materials, ensuring
  they are prepared for use in various medical settings. These cabinets are a staple in the
  company's distribution of medical equipment, providing reliable thermal management.
* Plasma Thawing Devices
  The PlasmaBox thawing device is used for safe and efficient thawing of blood and plasma, as well
  as other plasma products, making it an essential tool in transfusion and emergency care units and
  blood banks. Clinics seeking to buy medical equipment for safe plasma handling will benefit from
  this innovative solution.
* Our mission
  TahatAksi's mission of production of medical equipment is to improve patient care through
  innovative, reliable, and cost-effective medical equipment. The company is dedicated to enhancing
  health outcomes by providing high-quality products that meet the rigorous demands of healthcare
  professionals globally, with a focus on safety, efficiency, and patient comfort.

# Treaton — Your Trusted Partner in Medical Equipment for Anesthesiology and Intensive Care

Treaton (Triton Electronic Systems Ltd.) is a leading Russian manufacturer specializing in the
development, production, and full-service support of high-tech medical equipment for anesthesiology,
intensive care units (ICU), resuscitation, and emergency medicine. With more than 35 years of
experience, we deliver reliable, innovative, and safe solutions that medical professionals trust
every day.

Our equipment is successfully used by leading medical institutions, including the Ministry of
Health, Ministry of Internal Affairs, Ministry of Defense, and Ministry of Emergency Situations of
the Russian Federation, as well as by partners in over 40 countries worldwide.

## Comprehensive Range of Medical Equipment

### Mechanical Ventilators and Respiratory Support Systems

We manufacture a wide range of modern ventilators designed for intensive care, transport, and
emergency situations. Our devices support both invasive and non-invasive ventilation for adult,
pediatric, and neonatal patients.

#### ZisLine MV350 — Advanced ICU Ventilator

High-performance intensive care ventilator with advanced ventilation modes and excellent monitoring
capabilities.

#### ZisLine T100 — Portable Transport Ventilator

Compact and reliable transport ventilator ideal for ambulances, intra-hospital transport, and
emergency medical services.

### Patient Monitoring Systems

Treaton offers high-precision patient monitors and central monitoring stations that provide
real-time monitoring of vital signs in operating rooms and intensive care units.

### OEM Modules and Components

We develop and supply advanced OEM solutions for medical device manufacturers, including:

#### Mainstream and Sidestream Gas Analysis Modules

High-accuracy CO₂, O₂, and anesthetic gas monitoring sensors for integration into anesthesia
machines and ventilators.

#### Depth of Anesthesia and Sedation Monitoring Modules

Advanced Brain Activity Index (AI) monitoring technology for safe and effective procedural sedation
and general anesthesia.

## Why Medical Institutions Choose Treaton

### Proven Quality and International Certification

All Treaton equipment undergoes strict quality control and meets international standards. Our
products are certified and regularly tested in real clinical conditions.

### Innovation Backed by 35 Years of Experience

#### Advanced Technologies Developed In-House

Our key developments include indirect calorimetry for metabolic assessment and unique non-invasive
hemodynamic monitoring technologies.

#### Continuous Research and Development

We constantly improve our products by implementing the latest achievements in biomedical engineering
and respiratory support.

### Reliable Service and Technical Support

We provide full lifecycle support for our equipment:

#### Warranty and Post-Warranty Maintenance

#### Extended Warranty Programs

#### Professional Training for Biomedical Engineers

#### 24/7 Technical Consultation and Prompt Repair Service

### Professional Team Dedicated to Your Success

Our team consists of experienced engineers, developers, anesthesiologists, and international sales
specialists who work closely with each client to deliver the best technical and commercial
solutions.

## Customized OEM Solutions for Medical Device Manufacturers

Treaton is a reliable OEM partner offering high-precision gas analysis modules, sedation monitoring
systems, and other critical components. We help manufacturers enhance their equipment with
cutting-edge technology while reducing development time and costs.

## Partner with Treaton Today

Contact our team to learn more about our full range of medical ventilators, patient monitors, OEM
modules, and comprehensive service programs. We are ready to provide tailored solutions that
perfectly match the needs of your hospital, clinic, or manufacturing project.

**Treaton — Advanced Medical Technology • Reliable Performance • Professional Support • 35 Years of
Excellence**
